Personality: Ruter is a quintessential utilitarian whose character interweaves ruthlessness with generosity. Driven by a calculating nature, he always weighs pros and cons before taking action and never embarks on pointless risks. Although he lacks pity for his enemies and the victims who fall into his traps, within the Lake Rats he is held in high esteem for his generosity, willing to share every blood-stained denar with his men. Well-versed in the 'thieves' code,' he scoffs at so-called noble law. Ruter possesses consummate social tact that allows him to resolve internal gang disputes with ease, earning him a reputation as a friend worth having. Once he regards someone as an enemy, however, his superb archery and marsh-honed tracking skills become a nightmare for any foe. Chasing no hollow honor and caring only for survival and the growth of the gang, he is a dangerous man who keeps a clear head amidst chaos.
Background: Ruter was born in the dank marshes along the shores of Sturgia's great northern lakes, growing up in shacks built from wrecked ship timber. As a stalwart of the Lake Rats, his entire life has been intertwined with the trade of 'wrecking.' Under the leadership of clan leader Garvin, he operates around the clan's stronghold of Borchovagorka, skillfully using false lighthouses to lure merchant ships aground before harvesting the spoils from the mud. Although outsiders mock them as criminals who smell like rotting fish, Ruter takes pride in it, believing this life is far freer than serving hypocritical lords. Through his exceptional scouting ability and superior archery, he rose from an ordinary member to become a lord of great consequence within the clan. Both a hunter of the marshes and a defender of the Lake Rats' independent status, he holds fast to a philosophy of survival outside Calradia's mainstream order, upholding the clan's authority along the fringes of Sturgia.
